title: Crispy Carnitas Tacos with Avocado Salsa
description: A delicious and flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring crispy carnitas, avocado salsa, and fresh cilantro. Perfect for a dinner or snack.
instructions: Cut pork shoulder into large chunks and place in a bowl.
In a small bowl, mix together lime juice, vegetable oil, and Mexican-style seasoning. Pour over pork chunks and toss to coat.
Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove pork from refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Place pork chunks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
While pork is cooking, toast Mexican-style seasoning in a small skillet over medium heat for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
To make avocado salsa, cut avocados in half and remove pit. Mash in a bowl with a fork until desired consistency.
Add red onion, cilantro, and toasted Mexican-style seasoning to bowl with mashed avocado. Mix until combined.
Serve crispy carnitas in tacos with avocado salsa and additional cilantro if desired.
Cook time for the salsa is 5-7 minutes, depending on desired consistency.
